failureClasses.description: Declared maturity does not match actual implementation state.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Split target maturity from certified maturity, then complete package-native route migration before restoring T3C.
requiredProof: manifest diff proves certified state is not overstated

failureClasses.description: Rendered shell/sidebar/header anatomy is local, nested, duplicated, or incomplete.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Use a real DashboardShell with one direct sidebar child, one main child, one header region, and one scroll owner.

failureClasses.description: Hidden markers are satisfying old validators without rendering real components.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Remove hidden markers and render the actual kit components or direct package imports.
requiredProof: source scan shows no hidden hdk/component markers

failureClasses.description: Compatibility/static route is still treated as package-native production UI.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Demote static routes to dev-review/redirect status and register the true package-native operator route.
requiredProof: production nav points to package-native route
compatibility route is dev-review or redirect only

failureClasses.description: Local CSS/spacing/colors/layout primitives still control the dashboard.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Replace local primitives with kit components/tokens or add expiring exceptions for narrow domain accents.

failureClasses.description: Charts are fake, hand-drawn, missing axes/states, or not backed by approved chart components.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Use approved chart wrappers with x/y units, hover/legend/state contracts, and proof screenshots.

failureClasses.description: Proof capture or Playwright evidence is missing.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Restore proof script/config and run local screenshot/workflow capture.

failureClasses.description: Development-only visual selector can load in production.
failureClasses.repairPattern: Guard selector scripts behind localhost/dev checks and assert production exclusion.
